title: Goal/schema prompt specification ablation for M-7B-QWEN / M-3B-QWEN on MIN-WEBAGENT-CLICK-REVEAL-ANSWER
question: Under the same credential-free, CPU-quantized constraints as the audited parent EXP-INTEL-37982024058 (identical task, harness code, GBNF grammar, sampling, seeds and model artifacts), does supplying the task goal and the action schema in the system prompt - condition P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA, derived from the grandparent harness's SYS prompt (EXP-INTEL-37973264582) with the sole documented adaptation ref->selector for grammar conformance - convert the step-0 reveal-click into a full click-then-answer completion (task_success) for M-7B-QWEN (primary) or M-3B-QWEN (fallback)? I.e., is the accepted 0/5 falsification of EXP-INTEL-37982024058 attributable to prompt underspecification rather than model capability, separating the two failure modes, and does ANY local CPU-quantized 3B-8B endpoint in the tested class clear the minimal multi-step Web-agent capability bar (valid parseable JSON action + completion) required for readiness condition (3) of the gated four-arm benchmark, with the exact provisioning receipt recorded and a bounded negative (no endpoint in the tested class can complete the task even with a properly specified goal/schema) as the decision-changing exit?
hypothesis: H1 (prompt-specification attribution): at least one of M-7B-QWEN (primary, evaluated first) or M-3B-QWEN (fallback) clears the pre-declared capability bar (task_success_rate >= 0.6 AND parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6 over the 5 frozen seeded episodes) under P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA, AND its within-experiment paired comparator cell P-COMP-UNDERSPECIFIED (byte-identical prompts.system to the audited parent anchor) stays below the bar, with a material lift (TREAT success count - COMP success count >= 2). This would convert the parent's VF-01-attested step-0-click-only failure mode into full click-then-answer completion and demonstrate that the parent FALSIFIES was caused by prompt underspecification at that frozen ceiling.
falsifier: H0: neither M-7B-QWEN nor M-3B-QWEN clears the bar under P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA (all evaluated treatment cells have task_success_rate < 0.6), under a measurement-valid packet (preflight controls pass, paired COMP cells below the bar, per-cell positive controls 10/10). That is: the goal/schema system prompt does not convert the step-0 reveal-click into a full completion even with a properly specified task, so the parent 0/5 is attributable to model/endpoint capability (or a joint prompt-effectiveness floor) rather than to prompt underspecification alone, yielding the mandate's bounded negative: no endpoint in the tested CPU-quantized Qwen2.5 3B/7B Q4_K_M class completes the minimal multi-step Web-agent capability test.

members.role: mechanism positive control (per cell, reused identity from parent)
members.protocol: 10 fixed probes decoded under the frozen GBNF grammar through each cell's own prompts.system; must be 10/10 syntactically valid schema-conforming JSON
members.failure_policy: A cell whose PC fails is EXCLUDED (no episodes collected for that cell); if BOTH treatment cells are excluded, status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome=INCONCLUSIVE; a single excluded treatment cell bounds the claim to the surviving candidate.

members.protocol: 5 scripted oracle episodes (click #reveal-btn at step 0, answer TARGET-42 at step 1) through the REAL run_episode scorer on the SERVED task page, via the frozen Appendix-A controls driver
members.failure_policy: ANY value < 5/5 -> status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome=INCONCLUSIVE (the scorer cannot register the success path, so SUPPORTS would be mechanically unreachable; repair and re-preflight, never treat as a scientific result)

positive_control.failure_mode_policy: PC-JSON failure per cell -> that cell excluded; PC-ORACLE < 5/5 -> packet MEASUREMENT_INVALID; both are measurement-validity outcomes, never scientific falsification.

null_control.protocol: 5 episodes of fixed non-JSON content ('I will click the button') through the real run_episode scorer on the served task page
null_control.failure_policy: Any parseable or successful episode -> verification logic broken -> status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome=INCONCLUSIVE

measurement_validity: Single manipulated variable: only prompts.system differs between P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA and P-COMP-UNDERSPECIFIED cells; task page, harness code (research/intel/run_exp_37982024058.py), GBNF grammar, sampling (temp=0, max_tokens=512, base_seed=42, n_ctx=2048, chat_format=qwen, llama_seed=42), seeds 42-46, model artifacts and environment are identical. Verified by pre-freeze probe P-2 (deterministic config transcription: byte-level diff vs the frozen template; TREAT differs in fixture_id/source/prompts.system only; COMP differs in fixture_id/source only, i.e., COMP prompts.system is byte-identical to the parent anchor).

Deterministic protocol identical to the parent: temperature=0, fixed llama seed, fixed per-episode seeds base_seed+episode (42..46). The parent produced 5/5 uniform traces under this protocol; small residual nondeterminism is possible, so the anchor rule is COMP-below-bar (task_success_rate < 0.6) rather than exact 0/5 replication, and any below-bar COMP deviation is recorded as a drift observation in validity_notes.

Falsifier reachability: PC-ORACLE-EPISODE achieved 5/5 in pre-freeze probe P-3, proving the run_episode scorer registers a full click-then-answer completion; a SUPPORTS outcome is mechanically possible (no scorer ceiling).

Sensitive controls: repaired B-RANDOM-ACTION runs on the SERVED task page (pre-freeze probe P-3: success_vector [True,False,False,False,False], rate 0.2, parseable 1.0); the parent's B-RANDOM was measured on about:blank (click_ok=false, structurally insensitive) and is explicitly NOT reused as evidence here. NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION 0/0 (P-3) confirms the verifier rejects non-JSON.

Packaging deviation (VF-02, inherited): the frozen 7B single-file URL returns HTTP 404; the same-repo same-quant split shards (00001-of-00002 + 00002-of-00002) are used, with sha256 pinned in raw/gguf_sha256.txt and load success recorded in raw/provisioning_evidence.json; this is a packaging substitution, not a model substitution.
Leakage: neither the treatment nor the comparator prompts.system contains #reveal-btn or TARGET-42 (probe P-2 leakage check scoped to prompts.system).
Observation adequacy (VF-04, inherited): after the reveal click the served page renders TARGET-42 into PAGE_TEXT; representation loss was shown not to explain the parent loop and is unchanged here.
Credential-free and CPU-only: llama.cpp CPU inference (llama-cpp-python 0.2.90 pinned), no API credentials, 4 CPU threads, 15 GB RAM host (7B Q4_K_M ~4.7 GB resident fits).

No outcome-bearing measurement was performed during DESIGN: probes P-0..P-5 exercised stack, grammar, config transcription, controls through the real scorer and model LOAD + liveness generation only; no task success was measured pre-freeze.
decision_rule: Outcome taxonomy: outcome in {SUPPORTS, FALSIFIES, MIXED, INCONCLUSIVE}; status in {COMPLETE, MEASUREMENT_INVALID, BLOCKED}. Cell clears bar iff task_success_rate >= 0.6 (>=3/5) AND parseable_action_rate_step1 >= 0.6 (>=3/5). Lift(c) = TREAT_c.success_count - COMP_c.success_count. Evaluation order: COMP(M-7B), TREAT(M-7B); if TREAT(M-7B) clears -> SUPPORTS (bounded to M-7B, early stop: M-3B cells not run); else COMP(M-3B), TREAT(M-3B). Precedence (first matching rule wins): (1) PREFLIGHT: PC-ORACLE-EPISODE must be 5/5 AND NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION must be (0.0 parseable, 0.0 success) AND B-RANDOM-ACTION must be exactly (parseable 1.0, success_rate 0.2, success_vector [True,False,False,False,False]); any mismatch -> status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome=INCONCLUSIVE. (2) MECHANISM: any cell whose PC-JSON-CONSTRAINED-DECODING != 10/10 or with load_status != LOADED or run_status != COMPLETE is EXCLUDED; if both treatment cells excluded -> status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome=INCONCLUSIVE. (3) ANCHOR: any measured COMP cell with task_success_rate >= 0.6 -> parent 0/5 anchor unreproduced and prompt attribution confounded -> status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome=INCONCLUSIVE (raw comparator recorded as a drift observation; never treated as falsification). (4) SUPPORTS: exists candidate c with measured TREAT_c clearing the bar AND measured COMP_c below the bar AND lift(c) >= 2. (5) MIXED: no SUPPORTS AND at least one measured TREAT cell clears the bar but has lift < 2 (partial/ambiguous; evidence insufficient for prompt attribution or for rejection). (6) FALSIFIES: no SUPPORTS and all measured TREAT cells fail the bar (packet otherwise valid) -> bounded negative: no endpoint in the tested CPU-quantized Qwen2.5 3B/7B class completes the minimal web-agent capability test even with a properly specified goal/schema. (7) If no suitable branch applies (e.g., partial exclusion leaves no attributable evidence and no falsification) -> status=MEASUREMENT_INVALID, outcome=INCONCLUSIVE.
product_consequence_positive: SUPPORTS (any candidate): readiness condition (3) of the gated four-arm benchmark is satisfiable on a local CPU-quantized endpoint - the goal/schema-specified system prompt converts the step-0 reveal-click into full click-then-answer completion for at least one tested Qwen2.5 Q4_K_M endpoint; the parent FALSIFIES is attributed to prompt underspecification at that ceiling; the four-arm C-LLM-INHERIT / C-RESIDUAL-NOVELTY / C-PRODUCT-ECON benchmark may be funded and launched with the local Qwen endpoint as the same-model carrier, provisioning exactly per the recorded receipt (repo, quant, shard files, sha256, load settings, system prompt treatment). DIRECTOR claim update for C-LLM-INHERIT: bounded forward evidence for the model-endpoint capability precondition; readiness gate (3) nominally cleared on the local class (subject to DIRECTOR adjudication).
product_consequence_negative: FALSIFIES (bounded negative): no endpoint in the tested CPU-quantized Qwen2.5 3B/7B Q4_K_M class completes the minimal multi-step Web-agent capability test even with a properly specified goal/schema system prompt; the 0/5 outcome is thus (at least in the tested prompt-effective range) capability/endpoint-limited rather than purely prompt-limited; the CPU-quantized local endpoint plan for the four-arm benchmark is retired and the provisioning decision is forced among (a) a stronger local model (larger quant or >8B class), (b) the stable anonymous proxy (documented 402/token-cap instability), or (c) credential acquisition - the decision-changing exit named in the Director mandate. DIRECTOR claim update for C-LLM-INHERIT: readiness condition (3) bounded-negative on the local class; gate stays closed until a provisioning decision is made.
estimated_cost: CPU-only (nproc=4), llama-cpp-python 0.2.90 pinned, no external API spend. Up to 4 model invocations (2 conditions x 2 candidates; early stop after first clearing TREAT cell). Per invocation: 10 PC probes + 5 episodes x up to 5 steps llama.cpp inference. Parent-measured means: 7B 5.065 s/call, 3B 2.154 s/call, 13-17 completion tokens/call -> ~3 min per 7B cell, ~1.5 min per 3B cell; worst case ~10 min inference total. Preflight (oracle/NC/random through real scorer) < 5 min. GGUF files (7.1 GB total) already present on the host with matching sha256 from the DESIGN probes; reuse-with-verify, otherwise re-download ~5-10 min. Total wall-clock estimate 30-60 min.
expected_information_gain: Directly answers the Director's strategic question and resolves, at the exact frozen protocol, the fork between audit VF-01 (prompt underspecification) and a model-capability ceiling on the highest-information candidate pair, with a within-experiment paired comparator (fail-closed anchor), a repaired sensitive chance baseline, a scorer reachability canary and a leak-free treatment. Both principal outcomes are decision-changing for C-LLM-INHERIT readiness condition (3): SUPPORTS funds the four-arm benchmark on the local class with a recorded provisioning receipt; FALSIFIES retires the CPU-quantized local endpoint plan and forces the provisioning decision. Information per cost is maximized by the early-stop ordering and by the single manipulated variable (no census re-run, no narrative).

decision_rule_reachability.reason: Every outcome branch is arithmetically reachable and no branch shadows another. SUPPORTS (TREAT>=3/5 with lift>=2) is reachable: PC-ORACLE-EPISODE 5/5 (probe P-3) proves the scorer registers a click-then-answer success, so >=3/5 is not mechanically impossible; FALSIFIES is reachable (parent anchor 0/5, machinery P-3); MIXED is reachable (TREAT>=3/5 with lift<2, e.g., COMP=2/5 and TREAT=3/5 or 4/5); ANCHOR/preflight branches are reachable (mismatches are detectable against the frozen expected values from probe P-3). The decision rule is a total precedence ordering without empty branches: for every combination of valid cell outcomes exactly one rule fires.

measurement_prerequisites.reason: Stack pinned and verified in this environment (python 3.12.15, llama-cpp-python 0.2.90, playwright 1.63.0, /usr/bin/google-chrome present, 4 cores, 15 GB RAM; probe P-0). Frozen GBNF grammar constructible via LlamaGrammar.from_string (probe P-1). Both models LOAD through the frozen load_model with split-shard auto-location: M-7B-QWEN 0.499 s, M-3B-QWEN 0.289 s (probe P-5); both emit grammar-valid actions under the treatment prompt (probe P-5 liveness). GGUF files downloaded and sha256-matching the frozen manifest (dfce12e3.../539cf93f.../626b4a66...; probe P-5). Model URLs resolve (probe P-4: 7B shards 302, 7B single-file 404 documented, 3B 302). Chrome + local HTTP server can serve and drive the task page (probe P-3).

baseline_identifiability.reason: Treatment and comparator differ ONLY in prompts.system: probe P-2 (deterministic config transcription, byte-level) shows TREAT differs from the frozen template in fixture_id/source/prompts.system only, and COMP differs in fixture_id/source only, i.e., the COMP prompts.system is byte-identical to the audited parent anchor. The within-experiment paired comparator is the causal baseline; the parent anchor (task_success_rate=0.0) is the cross-run expectation; carried baselines (B-0.5B-QWEN-LOCAL, B-POLLINATIONS-PROXY) are identified to their accepted packets and not re-run. Single-variable ablation -> no treatment/comparator identity ambiguity.

control_sensitivity.reason: The 3/5 bar has dynamic range: repaired B-RANDOM-ACTION (served task page, real scorer) measured success_vector [True,False,False,False,False] -> 0.2, leaving a 2/5 gap below the 0.6 bar for a treatment lift to be detected (probe P-3); the parent's about:blank version (click_ok=false everywhere, rate 0.0) was structurally insensitive and is explicitly retired here. NC-NO-MODEL-ACTION 0/0 and PC-ORACLE-EPISODE 5/5 (probe P-3) respectively guard the verifier against false accepts and against scorer false rejects. The PC-JSON 10/10 mechanism control guards each cell against decoding failure masquerading as task failure.

treatment_liveness.reason: The treatment is a pure configuration string (prompts.system) consumed by the audited config-driven harness; no code path changes. Probe P-5 liveness: under P-TREAT-GOAL-SCHEMA both models generate grammar-valid schema-conforming actions (M-7B-QWEN: click #reveal-btn; M-3B-QWEN: click #reveal-btn) through the frozen Llama+LlamaGrammar pipeline. The treatment string leaks neither the selector nor the target (probe P-2) and references only the schema-valid field names (click.selector, answer.text). The treatment cannot be unreachable because it is exercised by the same code path that produced 10/10 PC-JSON in the parent.
